own_solution.law: The capacitor sees a Thevenin resistance Rth = (4.7 kΩ)(6.8 kΩ)/(4.7 kΩ + 6.8 kΩ) = 2.77913 kΩ. Its voltage is V(t) = Vfinal[1 - exp(-t/(Rth C))], so t90 = Rth C ln(10).
assumptions: The stated initially uncharged condition applies at switch closure.
For the added parallel capacitance variants, the combined capacitance starts at zero voltage.
The flash unit and its battery are electrically separate from the charging circuit.

defect_reasons.rendering_not_minimal: TA387 and T7FFF specify only a 'small amount' of additional capacitance, whereas the corresponding numerical variants specify 15 μF, violating the required preservation of number and unit.

notes: The base circuit has a unique charging time under its stated initial condition. Adding 15 μF gives a total capacitance of 37 μF. Earlier-run additions have no effect on the present run with the stated initial condition. Both emf sentences are assigned C by interpreting 'the battery' as the main circuit battery; because the description also mentions the flash battery, that reference has a wording ambiguity. If it instead refers to the separate flash battery, its role is D and the numerical answer remains unchanged. No information beyond this packet was consulted.
